# T-2: Validate snapshot hooks

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Separate snapshot reconciliation failures from hook run business failures so disabled, missing, unresolved, and metadata-mismatched snapshot entries hard-fail the flow command.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2 and AC3 through AC5 are covered for disabled, removed, unresolved, and metadata-mismatched snapshot entries.
- Failures include plugin id, module, and actionable restore/enable/re-prepare guidance.
- The command returns non-zero for invalid snapshot state.

## Implementation Notes
Refactor loadHookClass/runFlowCommandHooks boundaries so pre-run validation errors are not caught by the non-blocking hook run warning path.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests call the snapshot runner with manipulated plugin package state and assert command-failing errors.
